TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd will staff CDA’s Safe-City CCTV Surveillance Network and Command & Control Centre with an integrated delivery team spanning civil works, network/ICT, and information security. We are SECP incorporated and tax-registered (ATL) with Islamabad as our HQ, supported by Lahore and Karachi offices for surge resourcing and specialist backstopping. [CO-PROFILE]

Certifications and standards will be applied directly to the RFP’s quality and security expectations. For the command-and-control data systems, we hold ISO 27001 and will operate the ISMS across design, deployment, access control, and operational handover artefacts required for a surveillance C2 environment. [CO-PROFILE] For overall project quality, we hold ISO 9001 and use documented procedures for design reviews, material/installation inspection records, and nonconformance/corrective-action management aligned to construction and ICT integration workstreams. [CO-PROFILE] Our delivery maturity is supported by CMMI Level 3 practices evidenced across prior deployments. [CO-PROFILE][CAP-009]

Key roles will be filled from our bench of six PMP-certified project managers and four PEC-registered engineers, including the Project Manager, Civil Works Lead, and Network/Security Lead required by CDA. [CO-PROFILE]

Quality assurance will be executed through a stage-gated plan:
- Design assurance (network/civil IFC packages), installation QA/QC checklists, and integrated testing (fibre, power, network, cybersecurity hardening).

HSE will be managed under our documented HSE policy, with site safety plans for infrastructure deployments and a record of zero reportable fatalities. [CO-PROFILE]

Mandatory gaps disclosed: our library does not yet evidence ISO 14001 certification or PEC constructor registration at category C‑B or higher; we will address these through certified subcontracting and/or rapid certification and registration prior to award, as required by CDA. [CO-PROFILE]
